queries.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_image, p.barcode, p.alert_quantity, pc.category_name, /* ========================================= PURCHASE PRICE Opening stock first, Latest purchase as fallback ========================================= */ COALESCE( pos.purchase_price_without_vat, lp.base_price_per_unit, 0 ) AS purchase_price_without_vat, COALESCE( pos.purchase_price_with_vat, lp.purchase_price, 0 ) AS purchase_price_with_vat, /* ========================================= TAX ========================================= */ COALESCE( pos.tax_type, CASE WHEN lp.tax_percentage > 0 THEN 'with_tax' ELSE 'without_tax' END, 'without_tax' ) AS tax_type, COALESCE( pos.tax_id, lp.tax_id ) AS tax_id, COALESCE( pos.tax_percentage, lp.tax_percentage, 0 ) AS tax_percentage, COALESCE( pos.tax_amount, lp.product_wise_vat_amount, 0 ) AS tax_amount, /* ========================================= PROFIT MARGIN ========================================= */ COALESCE( pos.profit_margin_percent, CASE WHEN lp.purchase_price > 0 THEN ( (lp.selling_price - lp.purchase_price) / lp.purchase_price ) * 100 ELSE 0 END, 0 ) AS profit_margin_percent, /* ========================================= FULL SELLING PRICE ========================================= */ COALESCE( NULLIF(pos.selling_price, 0), NULLIF(lp.selling_price, 0), 0 ) AS selling_price, /* ========================================= PACK / UNIT INFORMATION ========================================= */ COALESCE( lp.quantity_per_pack, 1 ) AS quantity_per_pack, COALESCE( lp.box_quantity, 1 ) AS box_quantity, /* ========================================= SELLING UNIT PRICE selling_price ------------------------------- box_quantity × quantity_per_pack ========================================= */ ( COALESCE( NULLIF(pos.selling_price, 0), NULLIF(lp.selling_price, 0), 0 ) / NULLIF( ( COALESCE(lp.box_quantity, 1) * COALESCE(lp.quantity_per_pack, 1) ), 0 ) ) AS selling_unit_price, /* ========================================= CURRENT STOCK ========================================= */ COALESCE( sl.total_stock, 0 ) AS total_stock FROM `products` `p` LEFT JOIN `product_category` `pc` ON `pc`.`product_category_id` = `p`.`product_category` LEFT JOIN product_opening_stock pos ON pos.product_id = p.product_id AND pos.status = "active" LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ppd.* FROM product_purchase_details ppd INNER JOIN ( SELECT ppd2.product_id, MAX(ppd2.purchase_details_id) AS latest_purchase_details_id FROM product_purchase_details ppd2 INNER JOIN product_purchase pp2 ON pp2.purchase_id = ppd2.purchase_id WHERE pp2.status = "active" GROUP BY ppd2.product_id ) latest ON latest.latest_purchase_details_id = ppd.purchase_details_id ) lp ON lp.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, SUM( COALESCE(qty_in, 0) - COALESCE(qty_out, 0) ) AS total_stock FROM stock_ledger GROUP BY product_id ) sl ON sl.product_id = p.product_id WHERE `p`.`status` = 'active' ORDER BY `p`.`product_name` ASC

SELECT sales.sales_id, sales.sales_invoice, sales.sales_date, sales.other_charge_on_all, SUM(sales_details.product_quantity_sold) AS Sale_Quantity, SUM(sales_details.total_sale_price) AS Total_Sale_Value, SUM(sales_details.unit_price) AS Unite_Price FROM sales LEFT JOIN sales_details ON sales.sales_id = sales_details.sales_id GROUP BY sales.sales_id, sales.sales_invoice, sales.sales_date, sales.other_charge_on_all ORDER BY sales_id DESC LIMIT 5
